snippet.title: Trailer Into The Net ~ fangame Megaman Battle Network
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for Into The Net, a fangame based on Megaman Battle Network crossover with. hack// games. hope you like to try since this is FREE. 

the game can be downloaded from itch.io and currently in submission for Game Off 2021 game jam. If you are also a member, kindly please help to rate please. 

https://divinelight.itch.io/intothenet

Note: There is one bug in the game in later area in which enemy symbol cannot be passed. To pass this, please use Gameshark code 84624 to kill all enemies on map. 
Video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kHRzqseHstk

Will update the game with fix after Game Jam finished. Apologize for the trouble
